about.title: About me
about.description:
Passionate about interactive experiences,
I design and develop mobile, web, and augmented reality applications.

Focused on AR and real-time, I often use Unity with AR Foundation or WebXR to craft immersive, interactive experiences.

I handle the full lifecycle: prototyping, UX, performance, CI/CD, and deployment.
My approach is pragmatic, iterative, and impact-driven.
